title: The enantiomers of alanine
caption: (S)-alanine, the form in proteins, and (R)-alanine are mirror images that cannot be superimposed. They have the same melting point and solubility, and rotate plane-polarised light by equal amounts in opposite directions.
alt: (S)-alanine and (R)-alanine as mirror images with a dashed mirror line between them.
description: Same atoms, same connections, opposite arrangement at the central carbon.
